name: Murder of Crows

targets.description: each creature of your choice in the Cone

summary: 30-foot Cone of crows: each creature you choose makes a Dex save or takes 5d6 Force and is Blinded (save ends it, and so does any healing); half damage on a success.
text: You summon a murder of deadly crows and loose it. Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot Cone from you makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure it takes 5d6 Force damage and has the Blinded condition; on a success it takes half as much damage and nothing else. A Blinded creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success, and the effect also ends if the creature regains any Hit Points. The crows vanish after they strike. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 4.
